roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This pivotal role is essential for maintaining high standards of patient care and staff competency.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring all clinical staff are up-to-date with best practices and regulatory requirements. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control efforts, conducting surveillance, implementing protocols, and educating staff to minimize infection risks within the facility.

This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive Registered Nurse to make a significant impact on both staff development and patient safety in a supportive environment.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility.
Demonstrated experience in staff education and development.
Proven experience in infection prevention and control practices.
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description: We are seeking an Experienced Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is a unique opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently acquired center, bringing your expertise to a dynamic and evolving environment. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in driving census growth and enhancing community presence.In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies, building strong relationships with referral sources, and representing the facility with professionalism. You will play a key role in showcasing the facility's commitment to quality care and patient satisfaction, ensuring its continued success and reputation within the community.This position offers a competitive compensation package for the right individual, reflecting your experience and impact. If you are a proactive and results-driven marketing professional looking to make a significant contribution, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Strong presentation and interpersonal skills
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and build community relationships
Proactive and results-driven approach to marketing and business development
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as-needed) opportunity offers exceptional flexibility, allowing you to balance your professional commitments with your personal life while making a significant impact on patient recovery.

In this role, you will provide high-quality physical therapy services to residents, helping them regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to develop and implement individualized treatment plans, ensuring optimal outcomes for each patient.

This is an urgent opening for a therapist eager to contribute to a supportive and patient-focused environment. We offer competitive hourly compensation for your expertise.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting
Ability to work on a PRN (as-needed) basis
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $39.00 - $40.00 based on experience.

description: Join a premier home health agency in Casper, WY, as a Full-time Registered Nurse (RN). This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated nursing professional to provide high-quality, compassionate care to patients in the comfort of their own homes, with a competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00.In this vital role, you will be responsible for comprehensive patient assessments, developing and implementing individualized care plans, administering medications, performing wound care, and educating patients and their families on health management. Your expertise will ensure patients receive the best possible care, promoting their recovery and well-being within their community.We are seeking an RN who is passionate about making a difference and thrives in an autonomous environment. If you are ready to take on a rewarding challenge with a supportive team, we encourage you to apply today.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Wyoming
Minimum of 1-2 years of nursing experience, preferably in home health or a related setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to work independently and manage a patient caseload
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $36.00 - $45.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Orthopedic (Hand) Surgeon to join a leading healthcare facility in New York City. This is an exceptional opportunity for a dedicated surgeon to provide specialized care for conditions affecting the hand, wrist, and forearm, contributing to a team committed to patient well-being and recovery.

This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, with significant earning potential heavily weighted towards bonuses. If you are a board-certified or board-eligible hand surgeon with a passion for excellence and a proven track record, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Orthopedic Surgery
Fellowship training in Hand Surgery
Active and unrestricted New York State Medical License
Minimum of 5 years of post-fellowship experience
Experience with Workers Compensation and No-Fault cases
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, with an annual salary ranging from $400,000 to $500,000. Compensation is heavily weighted towards bonuses, providing significant earning potential based on performance.

description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, known for its commitment to patient care and a supportive environment. This facility, with a capacity of 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, is ideally located on a main street with abundant shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building. You'll enjoy the convenience of being just 15 minutes from the beach, offering a fantastic work-life balance.

As a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA), you will play a crucial role in helping patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life. You will work within a dedicated team, utilizing two courtyards for therapeutic activities, to provide high-quality rehabilitation services. This is an urgent opening for a professional who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of residents.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program.
Current and valid PTA license in the state of Florida.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation setting is preferred.
Excellent clinical skills and a patient-centered approach.
Ability to collaborate effectively with a multidisciplinary team.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.

description:
Join a highly reputable company known for its long-term employee retention, serving commercial and industrial clients across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area. We are seeking skilled Commercial/Industrial HVAC Technicians/Installers to become a vital part of our dedicated team.

This full-time role involves travel within Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana, providing essential HVAC services including installation, maintenance, and repair of commercial and industrial systems. If you are an experienced professional looking for a stable career with a company that values its employees, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum 5-7 years of overall HVAC experience
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience
Proficiency with Boilers and Chillers
Experience in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) is a plus
Not accepting candidates right out of school
